body:
Thanks for the detailed report!

CC @clayjohn as you seemed to reproduce the same.

Could either of you get a stacktrace from a build with debug symbols? Compile latest `master` with `debug_symbols=yes`.

Leshy, since you're on Fedora, you can then run the build through `gdb`, and let Fedora download the debug symbols for Mesa when it asks (talks about debuginfod) so that we also get details on where it's crashing in the Intel driver.

I'll have a bisect finished in a few minutes. So @Leshy-YA No need to bisect yourself. I started a bisect last night but had to leave before it finished. 

~based on where I got to though, I strongly suspect the issue is the same as https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/113909 and will be solved by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/114419~ I tested https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/114419 and it didn't solve the crash. Will continue debugging

_edit: Bisect finished. It points to c78c3ba894ab3b80079a6249b35d047c6fd0a6c1, which further confirms my suspicion_

There are VVL errors about shaders with FP16 failing SPIR-V validation, so it might be related:
```
ERROR: Vulkan Debug Report: object - 0
vkCreateShaderModule(): pCreateInfo->pCode (spirv-val produced an error):
Result type component width must be 32 bits
  %4072 = OpDPdx %v3half %4071

Command to reproduce:
        spirv-val <input.spv> --relax-block-layout --target-env vulkan1.2

The Vulkan spec states: If pCode is a pointer to SPIR-V code, pCode must adhere to the validation rules described by the Validation Rules within a Module section of the SPIR-V Environment appendix (https://docs.vulkan.org/spec/latest/chapters/shaders.html#VUID-VkShaderModuleCreateInfo-pCode-08737)
   at: _debug_report_callback (drivers/vulkan/rendering_context_driver_vulkan.cpp:665)
```
Before you check, it doesn't appear to be re-spirv's fault, but you may want to try without it anyway. `--generate-spirv-debug-info` command line option is a fast way to disable it.

> Before you check, it doesn't appear to be re-spirv's fault, but you may want to try without it anyway.
